changelog:
- Initial release of the family-memory skill.
- Enables agents to store, recall, and search family-related details using BlueColumn persistent memory.
- Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
- Includes example API requests for storing, noting, and recalling family information.
- Workflow guidance and link to full API documentation provided.
summary: Give AI agents Remember family details. using BlueColumn persistent memory. Use when an agent supports family coordination; when the user wants to store, recall, or search family memory context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
